# Ace Spaces — Complete Technical & Material Specification Reference (LLMs Full)

## 1. Executive Summary & Corporate Architecture
Ace Spaces Private Limited is the authorized DuPont™ Corian® solid surface master distributor, mineral slab stockyard, and advanced digital fabrication facility based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India.
Ace Spaces serves as the foundational material provider and engineering infrastructure for leading architectural practices, interior design studios, real estate developers, and its sister brand Coro Collective.

- **Headquarters & Specifier Showroom**: #42/1, 100 Feet Road, HAL 2nd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India
- **Central Stockyard & Automated CNC Plant**: Whitefield-Hoskote Industrial Corridor, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067, India
- **Contact Desk**: +91 98450 12345 / studio@acespaces.in
- **Website**: https://acespacesindia.vercel.app

## 2. Chemical Formulation & Health Profile
- **Polymer Phase**: ~33% high-purity Poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) acrylic matrix.
- **Mineral Phase**: ~66% Aluminium Trihydrate (ATH), Al(OH)3, refined from natural bauxite ore.
- **Pigmentation**: Through-body UV-stable metal-oxide and mineral pigments.
- **Zero Crystalline Silica (0.00% SiO2)**:
  - Ace Spaces homogeneous solid surface contains zero crystalline silica.
  - Generates zero toxic crystalline silica dust when cut, routed, thermoformed, or sanded.
  - Safe for fabricators, installation teams, and building occupants.
- **Non-Porous Surface Structure**:
  - Water Absorption (ASTM D570): <0.1% after 24-hour immersion.
  - Solid, homogeneous core throughout total thickness (no applied gel-coat or veneer).
  - Bacteria, virus, and mould resistant without chemical biocides.
  - Seamless molecular welding eliminates dirt lines and silicone caulk joints.

## 3. Mechanical & Physical Properties
| Property | Test Method | Typical Value |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Specific Gravity | ASTM D792 | 1.73 – 1.78 g/cm³ |
| Tensile Strength | ASTM D638 | 40 – 50 MPa |
| Tensile Modulus | ASTM D638 | 8,000 – 9,500 MPa |
| Flexural Strength | ASTM D790 | 65 – 75 MPa |
| Flexural Modulus | ASTM D790 | 8,500 – 10,000 MPa |
| Rockwell Hardness | ASTM D785 (M Scale) | 85 – 92 |
| Barcol Hardness | ASTM D2583 | 55 – 62 |
| Thermal Expansion Coefficient | ASTM D696 | 3.0 × 10⁻⁵ / °C |
| Heat Resistance | NEMA LD3-3.06 | No effect up to 100°C continuous |
| Fire Rating / Surface Burning | ASTM E84 | Class 1 / Class A (Flame Spread <25, Smoke <450) |
| Food Contact Safety | NSF/ANSI Standard 51 | Certified for all commercial and residential food zones |
| Indoor Air Quality | GREENGUARD Gold | Certified ultra-low VOC emissions (CDPH Standard Method v1.2) |

## 4. Calibrated Slab Formats & Tolerances
- **Standard Slab Length**: 3660 mm (± 2 mm)
- **Standard Slab Width**: 760 mm (± 2 mm)
- **Thickness Formats**:
  - **12.0 mm (± 0.3 mm)**: Primary gauge for kitchen benchtops, vertical wall cladding, integrated vanity bowls, monolithic reception desks, and thermoformed organic curves.
  - **19.0 mm (± 0.4 mm)**: Heavy-duty gauge for massive cantilever plinths, commercial counters, and freestanding sculptural monoliths.
- **Slab Squareness**: Diagonal variation < 1.5 mm across full 3660 mm sheet.

## 5. Architectural Product Systems & Typologies
1. **Monolithic Benchtops & Kitchen Islands**:
   - 45° mitred continuous waterfall returns.
   - Hand-honed seamless joints with color-matched methacrylate resin.
   - Heat deflection underlayment around cooktop cutouts.
2. **Integrated Sinks & Seamless Basins**:
   - Bowls molecularly fused into the deck without silicone caulk rims.
   - Coved internal radiuses (R10mm) preventing dirt accumulation.
   - 100% renewable matte or semi-gloss finish.
3. **Linear Washplanes & Concealed Drains**:
   - Sloped fall-planes directing water to continuous hidden trough slots.
   - Accessible stainless steel access trays for commercial facility maintenance.
4. **Cantilevered Floating Vanities**:
   - Internal steel sub-chassis engineered for heavy public or residential loads.
   - Integrated towel slots, tissue dispensers, and push-to-open fascia.
5. **Commercial End-of-Trip (EOT) & Public Grooming**:
   - Vandal-resistant, scratch-buffable surfaces for high-turnover corporate towers.
   - Touchless tap and soap dispenser integration.
6. **Clinical Healthcare & Surgical Scrub Sinks**:
   - Non-porous bacteriostatic solid surface conforming to HTM 64 / hospital hygiene regulations.
   - Deep anti-splash geometry with sloping rear coves.
7. **Bespoke 3D Thermoformed Architecture**:
   - Double-curvature wall cladding, organic reception spirals, and faceted light features.

## 6. Digital Fabrication Machinery & Standards
- **5-Axis CNC Milling**:
  - High-frequency 12 kW liquid-cooled spindles with multi-tool automatic changers.
  - Positional repeatability < 0.15 mm.
  - Nesting optimization delivering >92% slab yield efficiency.
- **Industrial Vacuum Membrane Thermoforming**:
  - Precision infrared and silicone platen heating tunnels to 160°C ± 3°C.
  - High-pressure double-membrane vacuum presses forming over CNC-milled MDF/timber bucks.
  - Minimum internal bend radius: 25 mm (12mm sheet) without color whitening or surface micro-fissuring.
- **Molecular Inconspicuous Joint Chemistry**:
  - 10:1 ratio two-part acrylic adhesives matched to each batch pigment code.
  - Structural bond strength exceeds the shear strength of the virgin substrate.
  - Seam lines buffed to match ambient 600-grit matte architectural sheen.

## 7. Sister Brand Integration — Coro Collective
Ace Spaces serves as the technical backbone and primary material supply for Coro Collective. Coro Collective’s bespoke spatial furniture and sculptural commissions are precision-milled, thermoformed, and hand-finished within Ace Spaces’ Bengaluru manufacturing plant. Architectural practices work with Ace Spaces to specify identical material formulations and fabrication rigor for their private projects.

## 8. Specifier Sample Tray & Consultation
- **Sampling**: Up to 6 curated 100mm × 100mm × 12mm material swatches dispatched pan-India with specifier technical data cards.
- **Digital CAD / BIM Submission**: Architects can submit `.dwg`, `.dxf`, `.step`, or `.rvt` drawings directly through https://acespacesindia.vercel.app/contact or via WhatsApp at +91 98450 12345.
